author: Kairos I
title: PPO with Spatial Attention LSTM
abstract: Replaces the default vanilla policy gradient training step with a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) clipped surrogate objective. This experiment tests the hypothesis that PPO's stability will improve performance on the SOTA Spatial Attention LSTM architecture (ID 410) without changing the network or the default hyperparameters.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import vmap, jit, lax
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

class SpatialAttention(nn.Module):
    features: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray) -> jnp.ndarray:
        batch_size, h, w, c = x.shape
        q = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(1, 1), name="Q_conv")(x)
        k = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(1, 1), name="K_conv")(x)
        v = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(1, 1), name="V_conv")(x)
        q_flat = q.reshape((batch_size, h * w, self.features))
        k_flat = k.reshape((batch_size, h * w, self.features))
        v_flat = v.reshape((batch_size, h * w, self.features))
        scores = jnp.matmul(q_flat, k_flat.transpose((0, 2, 1))) / jnp.sqrt(self.features)
        weights = nn.softmax(scores, axis=-1)
        attention_out = jnp.matmul(weights, v_flat)
        return attention_out.reshape((batch_size, h, w, self.features))

class CNNAttentionLSTM(nn.Module):
    lstm_features: int
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None) -> Tuple[jnp.ndarray, jnp.ndarray, Dict]:
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state = { 'h': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)), 'c': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)) }
        if done is not None:
            done_mask = done.reshape(batch_size, 1)
            rnn_state = { 'h': rnn_state['h'] * (1 - done_mask), 'c': rnn_state['c'] * (1 - done_mask) }
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        conv2_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv2_in
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        conv4_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = x + conv4_in
        cnn_out = nn.relu(x)
        attention_features = SpatialAttention(features=self.cnn_features_2)(cnn_out)
        x = cnn_out + attention_features
        x = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        lstm_cell = nn.LSTMCell(features=self.lstm_features)
        (rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), lstm_out = lstm_cell((rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), x)
        x = nn.Dense(features=128)(lstm_out)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(x)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNAttentionLSTM(
        lstm_features=hparams['lstm_features'],
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )

@jit
def calculate_gae(rewards: jnp.ndarray, values: jnp.ndarray, dones: jnp.ndarray, gamma: float, gae_lambda: float, next_values: jnp.ndarray) -> jnp.ndarray:
    values_t_plus_1 = jnp.concatenate([values[:, 1:], next_values[:, None]], axis=1)
    not_done_mask = (1.0 - dones.astype(jnp.float32))
    deltas = rewards + gamma * values_t_plus_1 * not_done_mask - values
    def scan_fn(advantage_t_plus_1, t):
        advantage_t = deltas[:, t] + gamma * gae_lambda * not_done_mask[:, t] * advantage_t_plus_1
        return advantage_t, advantage_t
    _, advantages = lax.scan(scan_fn, jnp.zeros(values.shape[0]), jnp.arange(values.shape[1] - 1, -1, -1))
    return advantages[::-1].T

def training_step(network: Any, optimizer: Any, params: Any, opt_state: Any, batch: Dict[str, jnp.ndarray], hparams: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
    observations, actions, rewards, dones, old_log_probs, old_values, final_values = (
        batch['observations'], batch['actions'], batch['rewards'], batch['dones'],
        batch['log_probs'], batch['values'], batch['final_values']
    )
    initial_rnn_states = batch.get('initial_rnn_states')
    advantages = calculate_gae(rewards, old_values, dones, gamma=0.97, gae_lambda=0.97, next_values=final_values)
    returns = advantages + old_values
    batch_size, trajectory_length = observations.shape[:2]

    def loss_fn(params):
        if initial_rnn_states is not None:
            def process_env_trajectory(env_idx):
                env_rnn_state = jax.tree.map(lambda x: jax.lax.stop_gradient(x[env_idx]), initial_rnn_states)
                def step_fn(carry, t):
                    obs, prev_done = observations[env_idx, t], jnp.where(t > 0, dones[env_idx, t-1], False)
                    logits_b, value_b, new_rnn_state_b = network.apply(params, obs[None, ...], prev_done[None, ...], jax.tree.map(lambda x: x[None, ...], carry) if carry is not None else None)
                    new_rnn_state = jax.tree.map(lambda x: x[0], new_rnn_state_b) if new_rnn_state_b is not None else None
                    return new_rnn_state, (logits_b[0], value_b[0])
                _, (env_logits, env_values) = lax.scan(step_fn, env_rnn_state, jnp.arange(trajectory_length))
                return env_logits, env_values
            all_logits, all_values = vmap(process_env_trajectory)(jnp.arange(batch_size))
        else:
            logits_flat, values_flat, _ = network.apply(params, observations.reshape(-1, *observations.shape[2:]), dones.reshape(-1))
            all_logits, all_values = logits_flat.reshape(batch_size, trajectory_length, -1), values_flat.reshape(batch_size, trajectory_length)
        
        log_probs_all = jax.nn.log_softmax(all_logits, axis=-1)
        new_log_probs = log_probs_all[jnp.arange(batch_size)[:, None], jnp.arange(trajectory_length), actions]
        ratio = jnp.exp(new_log_probs - old_log_probs)
        
        adv_detached = jax.lax.stop_gradient(advantages)
        adv_detached = (adv_detached - adv_detached.mean()) / (adv_detached.std() + 1e-8)
        
        unclipped_obj = ratio * adv_detached
        clipped_obj = jnp.clip(ratio, 1.0 - 0.2, 1.0 + 0.2) * adv_detached
        policy_loss = -jnp.mean(jnp.minimum(unclipped_obj, clipped_obj))
        
        value_loss = 0.5 * jnp.mean((all_values - jax.lax.stop_gradient(returns)) ** 2)
        entropy = -jnp.mean(jnp.sum(jax.nn.softmax(all_logits, axis=-1) * log_probs_all, axis=-1))
        
        return policy_loss + hparams['value_loss_coef'] * value_loss - hparams['entropy_coef'] * entropy

    grads = jax.grad(loss_fn)(params)
    updates, opt_state = optimizer.update(grads, opt_state, params)
    params = optax.apply_updates(params, updates)
    return params, opt_state
